name: Ashton Lagoon, Union Island

location.place: South coast of Union Island, St Vincent and the Grenadines

consent.notes: Listed from public reports as a candidate. Community details, boundary and claims wait for SusGren and the community to confirm. Location is an approximate centroid.

claims.value: Tidal flow cut by the causeway of an abandoned 1990s marina project

remuneration.mechanism: To be defined with the keepers
remuneration.local_value: To be defined with the community.

stories: The largest mangrove forest and lagoon in St Vincent and the Grenadines. A marina project abandoned in the 1990s left a causeway that cut its tidal flow; SusGren and the community have been restoring it since 2017.

name: Bermuda Platform seagrass meadows

location.place: Bermuda Platform, offshore and nearshore meadows

keepers.organisation: Government of Bermuda, Department of Environment and Natural Resources

consent.notes: Listed from published research as a candidate; to be confirmed with the Government of Bermuda and local partners.

evidence.source: Murdoch et al. 2007, as reported in Holzer and McGlathery 2016 (Marine Biology)

claims.value: Overgrazing by juvenile green turtles (Chelonia mydas)

evidence.source: Fourqurean et al. 2019, Estuaries and Coasts
Fourqurean et al. 2010, Marine Ecology Progress Series

stories: Nearly half of Bermuda's offshore seagrass (about 475 of 900 ha) was lost; a decade of monitoring at 17 sites found decline at all of them and attributed it to green turtle grazing. A test of the registry's rule that condition must be watched, not assumed.
